title: Check Rental Affordability in VIC
text: https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-xzha0419/ package aims help tenants answer question: “local government area can really afford rent ?” Rental affordability personal. Published median rents readers, whether rents affordable differs households incomes $900 $2,500. package therefore includes published rental data also function checks areas user-specified income. also includes Shiny app visualizes results allows users compare rental prices three LGAs time.

title: Check Rental Affordability in VIC
text: vic_rents includes quarterly median advertised rents June 1999 September 2025 property type. data 58,618 rows covering 79 local government areas, 7 property types 106 quarters. Cautions - Median number include newly signed leases whole market. - Homes Victoria replace median price NA quarter lettings. Source: Homes Victoria, Rental Report — Quarterly: Quarterly Median Rents LGA, September quarter 2025, published data.gov.au Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Australia licence. script downloads reshapes source workbook data-raw/vic-rents.R.
